extension.description: Monitor every GitLab pipeline in the current project, filter branches and tags, inspect job logs, and run manual jobs from VS Code.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: The extension reads the local Git remote and connects to its GitLab instance. Trust the workspace before using it.
view.name: GitLab Pipelines
configuration.title: Farrago GitLab Pipelines
configuration.remote.description: Git remote used to detect the GitLab project.
configuration.baseUrl.description: GitLab instance URL. Leave empty to infer it from the Git remote.
configuration.projectPath.description: GitLab project path (group/subgroup/project). Leave empty to infer it from the Git remote.
configuration.pipelineLimit.description: Number of recent pipelines to display across branches and tags.
configuration.refreshInterval.descriptio: Automatic refresh interval in seconds. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.
